# Evaluation: lung-efficientnet-b0-506c398b-onnx

*Generated by `ai-service/scripts/evaluate-cancer-models.py` on 2026-11-16.*

**Data:** LungCancer4Types (Kabil007, Apache-2.0): the model author's own 165-image held-out test split (data/splits/test_dev_split.csv at the pinned model revision; the model was trained on the other 659 de-duplicated images). Split here by near-duplicate cluster: 40% calibration, 60% test.

Calibration split: 67 images. Test split: 98 images (98 groups).
